patterns.name: account-number-in-context
patterns.description: 4-digit number adjacent to a payment method token. Add documentation example lines to allowlist, or append '# nocheck' to suppress individual lines.
patterns.message: Possible account number adjacent to payment method token

patterns.name: credential-assignment
patterns.description: Credential key followed by what appears to be a real value. Placeholder values (placeholder, example, test, fake, xxx, $variables, {templates}) are not flagged.

patterns.name: email-address
patterns.description: Email address not using a recognised placeholder domain (example.com, placeholder.com). Add your own placeholder domains to the allowlist.
